statement:
{f} {F} {a b} (hab : a < b) {ℓ} (hfint : ∀ n, HasIntegral (f n) a b (ℓ n)) (hfF : UnifConv f F) :
  ∃ L, SeqLim ℓ L ∧ HasIntegral F a b L
name: RealAnalysisGame.Integrable_of_UnifConv
content: If `fₙ` converges uniformly to `F`, and each `fₙ` is integrable on `[a, b]`, then `F` is integrable on `[a, b]`, and the integral of `F` equals the limit of the integrals of `fₙ`.
